He scored 73 goals for club and country during the 2025 to 26 season.
Alexia Putellas claimed her third Women's Ballon d'Or.
She is the sixth consecutive Spaniard to win the award.

It was the first time the event left France or Switzerland.

facts: Harry Kane won the Men's Ballon d'Or for the first time in his career.
Alexia Putellas won the Women's Ballon d'Or for the third time in her career.
The 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony took place on 26 October 2026 at the London Palladium in London.
Harry Kane scored 73 goals for club and country during the 2025 to 26 season.
Alexia Putellas became the sixth consecutive Spaniard to win the Women's Ballon d'Or.
The ceremony was organised outside France or Switzerland for the first time.
Kane is the 4th Bayern Munich player to win the Ballon d'Or.
Kane became the fifth Englishman to win the Ballon d'Or.
